title: Pure Kozmo
summary: Pure Kozmo Psychic-and-Machine tag-out build with generic Psychic starters and Rank 5 Cyber Dragon Xyz. Level 1 to 5 Psychic Pilots banish themselves as a Quick Effect on either turn to Special Summon higher-Level Kozmo Spaceships from the hand, while the high-Level Machine Spaceships float into lower-Level Kozmos from the Deck or hand when destroyed.

summary.title: Starters
points: Kozmo Tincan (Level 1 Pilot) pays 500 LP in the End Phase to reveal three Kozmo cards with different names from the Deck, adding one random pick to your hand and sending the other two to the GY, while retaining its Quick Effect to banish itself and summon a Level 2+ Kozmo from the hand.
Emergency Teleport and One for One Special Summon Kozmo Tincan, Kozmo Strawman, or Kozmo Farmgirl directly from the Deck without using your Normal Summon.

Kozmotown (searched by Terraforming) returns a banished Psychic Kozmo to your hand once per turn for 100 LP per Level, mulligans Kozmo cards in hand, and searches any Kozmo card when destroyed in the Field Zone.

summary.title: Opening: Kozmo Tincan + Kozmotown
steps: Normal Summon Kozmo Tincan (or summon it via Emergency Teleport or One for One) and activate Kozmotown.

In the End Phase, pay 500 LP with Tincan to reveal Kozmo Dark Destroyer, Kozmo Sliprider, and Kozmoll Dark Lady from the Deck;whichever card is added to your hand can be Special Summoned on the opponent's turn by banishing Tincan as a Quick Effect.
On the next turn, use Kozmotown to add the banished Tincan back to your hand, or summon Kozmo Strawman to Special Summon a banished Spaceship whose End Phase destruction triggers its Deck-float.

summary.title: Pilot Tag-Outs & Spaceship Floating
summary.text: Every Psychic Pilot (Tincan, Strawman, Farmgirl, Soartroopers, and Dark Lady) can banish itself during either player's turn to dodge targeting or follow up an attack with a fresh Spaceship from the hand. Kozmo Farmgirl pays 500 LP on battle damage to search any Kozmo card, and Kozmo Soartroopers pays 1000 LP to revive a Psychic Kozmo from the GY (such as Dark Lady or a Pilot dumped by Tincan). When a Machine Spaceship is destroyed by battle or card effect—including by your own Kozmo Dark Destroyer or Kozmojo—it banishes itself from the GY to float into a lower-Level Kozmo from the Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Kozmo Dark Destroyer (3000 ATK) cannot be targeted by the opponent's card effects, destroys a monster on summon (including itself to float down into Strawman or Dark Lady), and floats into any Level 7 or lower Kozmo from the Deck.

Kozmoll Dark Lady pays 1000 LP as a Quick Effect to negate and destroy an opposing monster effect, while Kozmo Dark Eclipser cannot be targeted and banishes a Kozmo from the GY to negate and destroy a Trap.
Two Level 5 Kozmo Slipriders (which destroy a Spell/Trap on summon) overlay into Cyber Dragon Nova and rank up into Cyber Dragon Infinity for an omni-negate that absorbs an Attack Position monster.
Kozmojo destroys a Kozmo monster you control to trigger its float and non-target banishes a card the opponent controls or in their GY.

summary.title: Spells & Recovery
points: Allure of Darkness draws two cards and banishes a DARK Kozmo monster from your hand, which Kozmotown immediately returns to your hand or Kozmo Strawman Special Summons to the field.
Leviair the Sea Dragon, made with Farmgirl and Soartroopers, detaches to Special Summon a banished Level 4 or lower Pilot.

allow.Emergency Teleport: Quick-Play Spell that Special Summons Level 1 Kozmo Tincan, Level 2 Strawman, or Level 3 Farmgirl directly from your hand or Deck.
allow.One for One: Limited to 1 in TCG: discards 1 monster to Special Summon Kozmo Tincan directly from your Deck.
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches the essential Kozmotown Field Spell.
allow.Allure of Darkness: Draws 2 cards by banishing a DARK Kozmo monster from your hand—which Kozmotown or Kozmo Strawman can then immediately recover or Special Summon!
allow.Cyber Dragon Nova: Rank 5 Machine Xyz summoned using two Level 5 Kozmo Slipriders to immediately rank up into Cyber Dragon Infinity.
allow.Cyber Dragon Infinity: Rank 6 Machine Xyz boss stacked over Nova that absorbs an opponent's Attack Position monster and provides once-per-turn omni-negation.

main: Kozmo Dark Destroyer

Signature Level 8 DARK Machine Spaceship (3000 ATK): cannot be targeted by opponent's card effects; targets 1 monster on the field on Normal or Special Summon and destroys it; when destroyed, banishes itself to summon any Level 7 or lower Kozmo from your Deck!
Kozmo Tincan

Core Level 1 LIGHT Psychic Pilot: Quick Effect to banish itself and summon a Level 2+ Kozmo from hand; during the End Phase, pays 500 LP to reveal 3 Kozmo cards from your Deck—your opponent adds 1 to your hand and the rest go to the GY!
Kozmo Strawman

Level 2 LIGHT Psychic Pilot: Quick Effect to banish itself and summon a Level 3+ Kozmo from hand; pays 500 LP to Special Summon a banished Kozmo monster—and when it is destroyed in the End Phase, it floats into another Kozmo from your Deck!
Kozmo Farmgirl
Level 3 LIGHT Psychic Pilot: Quick Effect to banish itself and summon a Level 4+ Kozmo from hand; pays 500 LP when inflicting battle damage to search ANY 'Kozmo' card.
Kozmo Soartroopers
Level 3 DARK Psychic Pilot: Quick Effect to banish itself and summon a Level 4+ Kozmo from hand; pays 1000 LP once per turn to revive any Psychic-Type Kozmo monster from your GY.
Kozmoll Dark Lady

Level 5 DARK Psychic Pilot (2200 ATK): Quick Effect to banish itself and summon a Level 6+ Kozmo from hand; pays 1000 LP as a Quick Effect when another monster activates its effect to negate and destroy that monster!
Kozmo Sliprider
Level 5 LIGHT Machine Spaceship (2300 ATK): destroys 1 Spell/Trap on the field on Normal or Special Summon, and banishes itself when destroyed to summon a Level 4 or lower Kozmo from your Deck.
Kozmo Forerunner
Level 7 LIGHT Machine Spaceship (2800 ATK): cannot be targeted by opponent's card effects, gains 1000 LP during every Standby Phase, and floats when destroyed into a Level 6 or lower Kozmo.
Kozmo Dark Eclipser
Level 9 DARK Machine Spaceship (3000 ATK): cannot be targeted by opponent's card effects, banishes a Kozmo from GY to negate and destroy a Trap, and searches a Level 8 or lower Kozmo when destroyed.
Kozmotown
Core Field Spell: returns a banished Psychic Kozmo to hand, mulligans Kozmo cards in hand, and searches ANY Kozmo card if destroyed in the Field Zone.
Kozmojo
Signature Normal Trap: targets and destroys 1 Kozmo monster you control (triggering your Spaceship's deck-float!), then banishes 1 card your opponent controls or in their GY without targeting!
Emergency Teleport
Special Summons Kozmo Tincan, Strawman, or Farmgirl directly from your Deck as a Quick-Play Spell.
Allure of Darkness
Draws 2 cards and banishes a DARK Kozmo monster from your hand, which Kozmotown immediately adds back to your hand!
One for One
Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Kozmo Tincan from the Deck.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Kozmotown.

Rank 6 Machine Xyz boss that absorbs an opponent's Attack Position monster and negates any card or effect.
